resolution.rejection_description: Rejected because the number of unique de-duplication candidates exceeded the permitted limit for a non-whitelisted applicant. Above that ceiling the candidate set cannot be adjudicated within the packet.
resolution.synthesis: The resident applied for a fresh enrolment and their biometrics matched more records than policy allows an operator to review for one packet, which usually points to a low-quality capture matching broadly rather than to a real duplicate. Uniqueness could not be assessed at all, so the packet was rejected together with the candidates that hold no Aadhaar. A new packet with a careful, high-quality capture of every modality is needed to narrow the candidate set.
